description:
# Goal

Make ExecutableEffects(E) an ordinary reactive per-executable product and delete its private reachability, SCC, snapshot, fixpoint, reverse-graph, and cone-invalidation machinery.

## Current defect

produce_executable_effects collects the reachable call cone, discovers SCCs, snapshots inputs, and settles a bespoke fixpoint. PullSession separately maintains latest_effect_inputs, effect_dependents, a typed executable_effects mirror, and manual reverse-cone invalidation. This is a batch pass plus a second authority embedded inside the product recalculator.

## Model

ExecutableEffects(E) reads E local materialized effect plus exact ExecutableEffects(callee) inputs through ProductMemo. Generic pending-product cycle handling owns cycles. The effect join is idempotent OR/union, so a call SCC answer is the union of member-local and external effects; it does not need a separate algorithmic authority.

## TDD and signal

- Acyclic chain, self-cycle, mutual cycle, edge addition, edge removal, dependency reversal with both old formulas displaced, unchanged local projection, and changed leaf.
- Exact reverse dependents reevaluate; unreachable executables do not.
- Product values, generations, backend artifacts, and runtime behavior remain identical; canonical causal work remains exact and cross-process deterministic.
- Every producer evaluation is attributed to an exact trigger or explicitly recorded as unexplained; formula evaluations remain zero-uncaused in cold, unchanged, and unreachable requests. The ordinary formula makes previously hidden cone work visible as direct product evaluations and demanded product keys; this expected work-shape change is pinned below rather than contradicted by an unchanged aggregate baseline.
- No cone collection, SCC discovery, snapshot replay, manual reverse effect graph, typed effect mirror, or end-session recomputation remains.
- Full library, fixture matrix, cross-process determinism, formatting, and clippy with warnings denied pass.

## Measured causal-work change

Tuple fields are producer evaluations / settlements / distinct demanded products / settled / first productions / cross-request recomputations / unexplained producer evaluations / formula evaluations / uncaused formulas. Settlements, settled products, first productions, cross-request recomputations, formula evaluations, and uncaused formulas are unchanged. Extra evaluations and demanded keys are the now-observable direct ExecutableEffects formula chain; the old producer performed the transitive MaterializedExecutable traversal and SCC fixpoint inside fewer producer evaluations.

The added unexplained producer counts (3 / 5 / 13 by fixture) are recursive ExecutableEffects members retried from a prior ExecutableEffects(callee) wait without an intervening product movement. fz-tfn.32 owns finding and correcting that generic product-wait retry cause without an effects-specific path or causality exception; it is nonblocking and intentionally remains at P4.

## Required deletions

Delete EffectGraph, cone/SCC helpers, snapshot settlement, latest_effect_inputs, effect_dependents, invalidate_effect_cone, executable_effects, effect record/query APIs, tests that only prove the retired mini-pass, and documentation describing it.
